[Problem]{.card-kicker} **XOR and Favorite Number** [CF 617E · XOR and Favorite Number](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/617/E){rating="2200"}

Subarray xors are differences of a **prefix xor** $p$: $p_0 = 0$, $p_x = a_1 \oplus \cdots \oplus a_x$, so $a_i \oplus \cdots \oplus a_j = p_j \oplus p_{i-1}$. The query $[\ell, r]$ asks for the number of pairs $p_x \oplus p_y = k$ with $\ell - 1 \le x < y \le r$ — that is, unordered pairs of *distinct* prefix values inside the index range $[\ell - 1, r]$ whose xor is $k$. Now it is a classic Mo window over the **prefix array**: maintain `freq[v]` = how many prefix values equal to $v$ are currently in the window, and a running count of good pairs. Letting a prefix value $u$ into the window pairs it with every present value equal to $u \oplus k$, so `add` is `pairs += freq[u ^ k]; freq[u]++` — $O(1)$, and `remove` its inverse. The Mo window lives on indices $[\ell-1, r]$ of $p$, which is the only index-translation wrinkle (@sec-mo-a1).

[Solved in full in @sec-mo-p1-xorfav.]{.card-link}

:::
